workload.events: One LedgerApplied Adjustment event per sequential ledger entry, all under one account and currency.
workload.operation: ReplayVerifier::replay(&[Event]) compared with ReplayVerifier::replay_owned(Vec<Event>), including EventLog append/validation/digest and Ledger projection.
workload.timing_boundary: Input fixture cloning for replay_owned uses Criterion iter_batched setup and is outside the measured routine; event cloning performed by the borrowed replay routine remains inside its measured routine.
pre_timing_checks: Borrowed and owned paths produce identical EventLog event sequences.
Borrowed and owned paths produce identical Ledger entries and cash projection.
Replayed event and ledger entry counts equal the input count.

limitations: Synthetic Adjustment entries, one account and one currency; no representative multi-position market workload.
Same-source borrowed-versus-owned API comparison, not a historical binary A/B.
No allocator counts, disk I/O, strategy execution, market-data processing, or end-to-end A-share profile measurement.
